target_moa.text: Istradefylline is an adenosine A2A receptor antagonist; the precise mechanism of its therapeutic effect in Parkinson disease is unknown

citations.quote: The precise mechanism by which istradefylline exerts its therapeutic effect in Parkinson disease is unknown. In *in vitro* studies and in *in vivo* animal studies, istradefylline was demonstrated to be an adenosine A_2\alpha receptor antagonist.
It is a first-in-class adenosine A2A receptor antagonist. Adenosine A2A receptors are found primarily on medium spiny neurons in the striatum.
NOURIANZ contains istradefylline, an adenosine receptor antagonist, which has a xanthine derivative structure.

summary.text: Nourianz (istradefylline) is a new molecular entity and first-in-class adenosine A2A receptor antagonist approved via a 505(b)(1) NDA as adjunctive treatment to levodopa/carbidopa in PD patients with 'off' episodes.
